replacements.old:
This note documents the completed formal certificate for MathDB item 352972,
the flat balance conjecture for finite simple graphs. The refutation is
re-derived from a fully generic bridge layer over arbitrary finite simple
graphs: the c(0) = 1 convention, finite support and cutoff invariance of the
parity clique sums, an exact convention decomposition, integer and real cast
bridges for the discrepancy, and a generic contrapositive. All results are
machine-checked under warnings-as-errors with a strict kernel recheck and a
fresh source-only cleanroom replay. The environment audit enumerates 156
declarations with axiom closure exactly {propext, Classical.choice,
Quot.sound}. The controls record contains ten positive proofs.
replacements.new:
This note reports the formal refutation of MathDB item 352972, the balanced-graph
conjecture for flat graphs. The production endpoint uses the generic discrepancy
contrapositive. Additional generic identities prove the empty-clique convention,
finite support, cutoff invariance, convention decomposition and integer/real cast
semantics. Independent Sol r7 review repeated strict builds, kernel checks, the
full 156-declaration audit and source-only replay. Its checked audit supplement
links the arbitrary-cutoff real formulation to the endpoint. The permitted axiom
closure is exactly {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}. The author controls
contain 11 example blocks under labels C1-C10.

without changing the two reviewed production proofs. It corrects the odd sum,

certificate report, with no claim of exhaustive worldwide novelty.
